title: The Patient Who Will Not Die
text: A pilgrim brought to your infirmary with a broken spine has not died in forty days. He neither eats nor sleeps. Every hour he asks, politely, to be allowed to go.

options.label: Grant him a merciful end, as he asks.

outcomes.text: He thanks the Scion who does it and closes his eyes. The Scion does not sleep that night.
It does not take. He thanks the Scion anyway, and the Scion asks to be moved to another wing.

options.label: Let the surgeons study him; a man who cannot die has much to teach.

outcomes.text: The surgeons learn more from him than from a hundred corpses.
The surgeons learn too much. When he is gone, one of them takes up his bed.

options.label: Carry him out of the gate, and let the road decide what he is.

outcomes.text: He is carried to the Rift Gate and set down. He stands and walks through it on his own, without looking back.
